steps.title: Optional HCl demineralization
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL of 0.6 M HCl (from falcon tube well 0) to each 1.5 mL Eppendorf containing 10–30 mg bone, then pause the robot and manually resume after 1–14 days of demineralisation.

steps.title: Optional NaOH neutralization
steps.instruction: Remove the acid from each Eppendorf into AqWaste (reservoir trough A1), add 250 µL of 0.1 M NaOH (from falcon tube well 2), vortex manually, centrifuge, then automatically discard the NaOH back into AqWaste.

steps.title: AmBIC gelatin extraction
steps.instruction: Distribute 100 µL of 50 mM AmBIC into each sample, incubate manually for 1 hour at 65 °C, centrifuge 1 minute, return tubes to the deck, and automatically transfer 50 µL of the gelatinised extract into the EXT Eppendorf tubes.

steps.title: Trypsin digestion
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of trypsin to each EXT Eppendorf, mix, incubate overnight at 37 °C, return tubes to the deck, then automatically add 50 µL of washing solution to quench the trypsin.

steps.title: Prepare zip‑tip plate
steps.instruction: Using a regular 1000 µL pipette, place 250 µL of conditioning solution and 350 µL of washing solution into the designated wells of the zip‑tip well plate.

steps.title: Filter sample and elute peptides
steps.instruction: With a 300 µL filter‑tip pipette, (1) draw 50 µL of conditioning solution twice, (2) wash the filter with 100 µL of washing solution (two draws), (3) aspirate the sample from the EXT Eppendorf and dispense back into the same tube 10 times, (4) wash the filter again with 100 µL washing solution (two draws), (5) draw 100 µL of conditioning solution and elute into a third well, mixing 10 times with 50 µL aliquots.
